cd /home/agent/.claude/projects/-app/*/tool-results/; cat > /tmp/parse.py <<'EOF'
import json,glob,base64,re
rows={}
for f in glob.glob('mcp-hg-gmail_get_messages_batch-*.txt'):
    d=json.loads(json.load(open(f))['result'])
    for m in d['messages']:
        data=m['payload']['body'].get('data','')
        t=base64.urlsafe_b64decode(data+'==').decode('utf-8','replace')
        rows[m['id']]=t
# add last two manually by decoding nothing; handled later
out=[]
for i,t in rows.items():
    if 'SVB' not in t[:60]: 
        print('NONSVB',t[:150]);continue
    mt=re.search(r'Notification: (.*?)\xa0',t)
    to=re.search(r'To: (.*?) \*\*\*(\d{4})',t)
    amt=re.search(r'Amount: ([\d,\.]+) ([A-Z]{3})',t)
    dt=re.search(r'Transaction Date: (\w{3} \d{2} \d{4})',t)
    out.append((dt.group(1) if dt else None, to.group(1) if to else None, to.group(2) if to else None, amt.group(1) if amt else None, amt.group(2) if amt else None, mt.group(1) if mt else None, i))
json.dump(out,open('/tmp/notices.json','w'))
print(len(out))
for o in out:
    if None in o: print('MISSING',o, rows[o[-1]][:600])
EOF

Leapblock's accountant closed our file on Feb 13 (#leapblock) and listed 30 USD wires totalling 407,944, including a first wire on 13 Sep 2023 for 33,290 that has no SVB Payment Processed notice. Per the counting note their close-out figure beats the notices; their yearly totals for 2024–2026 match the notices exactly, so the extra 33,290 goes to Domino Delights.

Line set at $13,975 (all Domino Delights), not the $6,450 on the SVB notices. Before the bank had him (Sep 2024) we paid Lucas through Western Union, and the receipts are in my mail: Jun 3 2024 $1,075, Jun 17 $1,075, Jun 29 $1,075, Jul 23 $2,150, Aug 23 $2,150 = $7,525 sent (fees excluded). 6,450 + 7,525 = 13,975.

Line kept at $0, not the $125 on the notice: Leonard says the May 2024 wire came back the same day. It was re-sent through Payoneer, but the only Payoneer emails in my mail are payment requests from the vendor (Dixelar, May 5 and Sep 25 2024), not receipts for money sent, so per the counting note nothing goes in. Bucket: marketing (ad videos).

Line kept at $0 with no bucket, not the $4,000 on the Aug 19 2024 notice. Blake confirmed by email on Feb 13 ("Chase records") that ***3203 is our own Chase account: he moved the money back after Carta's renewal came out of Chase. Money moved between our own accounts isn't spending.
